name: The Molten Core
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Requires level 55 instead of 57. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
adventurer, perhaps it is time to give you a real test.  Are you ready?

At the bottom of Blackrock Depths is a passage to the Molten Core.  This is a stronghold of our enemy, held by the most powerful servants of fire on this world.

Go to the Molten Core, adventurer.  Show me you have the strength and the will to defeat what you find there.

And if you have allies among your people, then rally them.  Nothing short of an army can hope to enter the Molten Core and live.
narrative.objectives: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have done what most of your kind would think impossible.  You have faced the beings of the Molten Core, and triumphed!For so small a creature, you have displayed great resource.Some day, perhaps we might strike a true allegiance between your kind and the Waterlords.
narrative.requestItemsText: Your success in the Molten Core awaits, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 56 to 60, 58,450 XP in all.

quests.name: Poisoned Water
quests.objectiveText: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Stormers and Rumblers
quests.objectiveText: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: Eye of the Emberseer
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: The Molten Core
quests.objectiveText: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: Agent of Hydraxis
quests.objectiveText: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: Hands of the Enemy
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: A Hero's Reward
quests.objectiveText: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.
